records.title: Understanding and Mitigating Bottlenecks of State Space Models through the Lens of Recency and Over-smoothing
records.reason: The paper analyzes SSM quality/representation bottlenecks and proposes polarization for recall/generalization; it does not establish an inference-efficiency contribution.

records.title: Small Singular Values Matter: A Random Matrix Analysis of Transformer Models
records.reason: The contribution is representational analysis/guidance rather than a demonstrated inference-compression method; no serving latency, throughput, or memory savings are established.

records.title: Mitigating the Language Mismatch and Repetition Issues in LLM-based Machine Translation via Model Editing
records.reason: The intervention edits LLM components to reduce translation errors and preserve quality; the abstract does not propose reducing inference cost, latency, or resource use.

records.title: Self-Updatable Large Language Models by Integrating Context into Model Parameters
records.reason: SELF-PARAM integrates information into model parameters through a training objective to improve memory/retention; this is not inference-time efficiency.

records.title: Fundamental Limits of Prompt Compression: A Rate-Distortion Framework for Black-Box Language Models
records.reason: Natural-language test data consists of ten short prompts with four queries each, and the work does not establish end-to-end serving latency/cost improvements on realistic long contexts.
